summary: A cab-over microvan: 3.4 m long, 1.5 m wide, wheels at the extreme corners and the driver sitting over the… joints side_door, barn_door_l, barn_door_r, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer …; options config, paint; sockets seat_driver, seat_pax_1, socket_driver, socket_cargo …; drivable (vehicles).
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.kei_van or place "prefab": "kei_van" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
Drive it from a behavior: e.get(Vehicle).drive(throttle=..., steer=...).
